messages.author: ea0dc7d20f577516
messages.subject: Re: Error in as.environment(x) : invalid object for 'as.environment'
parts:
Of course, sorry!  I believe I did something along the lines of (roughly as recommended by Ista - thanks):

- uninstalled the packages "ggplot2", "scales", "plyr", "reshape2", "gtable",
- then closed R,
- then deleted the package folders from "lib" (of the current R version in question),
- then reinstalled those packages again,
- and did an update.packages()

Hope that helps!
